description: Replace all inline SVGs in top-header.html and chat-panel.html with <app-icon> usages. Add IconComponent to both components' imports arrays. Fix ai-logo colors via CSS. Depends on FEAT-001 (IconComponent and sprite must exist first).
steps: Edit src/app/components/top-header/top-header.ts: add `import { IconComponent } from '../../shared/icon/icon';` and add IconComponent to the imports array: imports: [CommonModule, IconComponent].

Edit src/app/components/top-header/top-header.html — replace 4 inline SVGs per plan.md §5.1: (1) doc-options first icon width=16 -> <app-icon name="file" size="16" />, (2) doc-options chevron width=14 -> <app-icon name="chevron-down" size="14" />, (3) notifications button width=18 -> <app-icon name="bell" size="18" />, (4) more-options button width=18 -> <app-icon name="dots-vertical" size="18" />.

Edit src/app/components/chat-panel/chat-panel.ts: add `import { IconComponent } from '../../shared/icon/icon';` and add IconComponent to the imports array: imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, IconComponent].

Edit src/app/components/chat-panel/chat-panel.html — replace 15 inline SVGs per plan.md §5.2: (1) AI avatar in message loop width=18 -> <app-icon name="ai-logo" size="18" />, (2) AI avatar in typing indicator width=18 -> <app-icon name="ai-logo" size="18" />, (3) attachment-icon class width=20 -> <app-icon name="file" size="20" class="attachment-icon" />, (4) attachment-success check width=18 -> <app-icon name="check" size="18" class="attachment-success" label="Upload successful" />, (5) source chip file width=11 -> <app-icon name="file" size="11" />, (6) thumbs-up width=14 -> <app-icon name="thumbs-up" size="14" />, (7) thumbs-down width=14 -> <app-icon name="thumbs-down" size="14" />, (8) copy width=14 -> <app-icon name="copy" size="14" />, (9) regenerate/refresh width=14 -> <app-icon name="refresh" size="14" />, (10) attach-btn paperclip width=16 -> <app-icon name="paperclip" size="16" />, (11) lang globe width=13 -> <app-icon name="globe" size="13" />, (12) lang chevron-down width=11 -> <app-icon name="chevron-down" size="11" />, (13) send width=16 -> <app-icon name="send" size="16" />, (14) voice/mic width=16 -> <app-icon name="mic" size="16" />.

Edit src/app/components/chat-panel/chat-panel.css — add CSS rules to restore the AI logo blue circle and white cross: `.ai-avatar svg circle { fill: #2563eb; stroke: none; }` and `.ai-avatar svg path { stroke: #fff; }`. These rules target the <svg> rendered inside <app-icon> when it is inside the .ai-avatar wrapper div.
acceptance_criteria: chat-panel.css contains rules for .ai-avatar svg circle and .ai-avatar svg path
Running `npx ng build --configuration development` completes with zero errors
verification: cd d:\IntelliDocs-AI\IntelliDocs-AI.Web && npx ng build --configuration development
